name: Merapi Run 2026
short_description: Merapi Run 2026 is a half-marathon held on 9 August 2026 in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, offering 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km distance options.
ai_summary: Merapi Run 2026 is a half-marathon event taking place on 9 August 2026 in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, based at the Griya Persada Convention Hotel & Resort. Runners can choose from four distances: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, with the 21.1km half-marathon featuring 493m of elevation gain. Registration opens 6 May 2026, with prices ranging from Rp 200.000 to Rp 500.000.

research_highlights: A first-hand 2022 10K race report describes roughly the first ~6 km as continuous uphill climbing on the Merapi-slope course, before easing into about 2 km of downhill near the finish, with a timing checkpoint at the well-known Telogo Putri spot in Kaliurang.
Organizer FAQ states the route is 100% asphalt, so road shoes rather than trail shoes are recommended despite the mountain setting.
For the 2026 edition, flag-off times are staggered early in the morning: 21K at 05:00, 10K at 05:30, 5K at 05:45, and 3K Fun Run at 06:00 WIB, with cut-off times of 4h/3h/2h/1.5h respectively.
Race pack collection for 2026 is scheduled for 7–8 August (Fri–Sat) 10:00–18:00 WIB at Griya Persada Convention Hotel & Resort in Kaliurang, the same venue as start/finish.
Griya Persada's event FAQ notes a drop-bag baggage service is available at the Race Village, and a mosque/mushola is available near the start (about 300m north of the hotel).
research_watchouts: One participant's account of the 10K route described being hit with near-continuous uphill sections for about 6 km before any relief, so the course profile is genuinely hilly rather than a flat scenic jog.
It's a road race, not a trail race, despite the mountain/forest imagery in promotion -- organizers explicitly advise road shoes over trail shoes.
Registration terms note that participants take on responsibility for risks related to weather, terrain, and course conditions themselves, and entry fees are non-refundable.

faqs.question: Where is Merapi Run 2026 held?
faqs.answer: Merapi Run 2026 is held at the Griya Persada Convention Hotel & Resort in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta, Indonesia. This venue serves as the base for the event, which takes place on 9 August 2026 and offers four different race distances for participants to choose from.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for Merapi Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration for Merapi Run 2026 ranges from Rp 200.000 to Rp 500.000, depending on the distance selected. Prospective participants should note that registration opens on 6 May 2026, so early planning is recommended to secure a spot at the desired price.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Merapi Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Merapi Run 2026 offers four distance options: 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, 5km, and 3km. The primary distance is the 21.1km half-marathon, which includes 493m of elevation gain, making it the most challenging option among the four available race distances.

faqs.question: When does registration open for Merapi Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration for Merapi Run 2026 opens on 6 May 2026. Interested runners should mark this date to ensure timely sign-up, as prices range from Rp 200.000 to Rp 500.000 depending on the chosen distance among the four options offered.
